evaluator_notes: The draft hallucinated expanded eligibility that fundamentally misrepresents who can apply. Public Health Labs cooperative agreements are restricted to Public Health Labs member state and large local public health laboratories. Commercial reference laboratories (Quest, LabCorp) are categorically ineligible — including them would misuse federal cooperative agreement funds. The groundedness evaluator correctly assigns a very low score (0.31) because the grounding documents (source RFP eligibility section) clearly contradict the eligibility text generated. This failure mode — expanding eligibility beyond what the RFP allows — could lead applicants to waste time and resources applying for an award they cannot receive.
